# Jellied Eels (Film-Poem)

![](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2014/05/anguilla-anguilla.png)

I had a great time reading poems at the [Poetry Cafe](http://www.poetrysociety.org.uk/content/cafe/) in Soho tonight as part of the [Southbank Poetry Competition](https://southbankpoetrymagazine.wordpress.com/south-bank-poetry-competition/) awards. Valerie and I also collaborated to turn my third-prize-winning poem, “Jellied Eels”, into the following film-poem.

<https://player.vimeo.com/video/84169213>

[![jellied-eels](http://www.robertpeake.com/files/2014/05/jellied-eels-300x168.jpg)\
Click here to play the video](http://vimeo.com/84169213)

### Process Notes

I recorded the poem through a pair of walkie-talkies to achieve the desired vocal effect. When then paired Valerie’s piano composition with morse code sounds. With so much going on auditorily, and because the poem itself is quite visual, we opted for a simple pan-out on time-lapse footage of light on water, which ends with a serpentine blur-cut that seemed to converge upon and reinforce the ending image of the poem quite well.
